title: virtuus-blobs crate: files beside the tables
description:
Design §3.1 (`virtuus-blobs`). A new workspace crate `rust/crates/virtuus-blobs`: add it to `members`; its specs are `@rust-only`.

## API
Over an `Arc<dyn Storage>`, rooted at `files/`:
- `put(key, bytes, content_type) -> FileRef { key, sha256, size, content_type }`
- `put_path(key, src: &Path, content_type, link: bool)`, which copies (or hard-links when `link`) while hashing
- `get(key) -> Option<Vec<u8>>`, `head(key) -> Option<FileRef>`, `delete(key) -> bool`
- `list(prefix) -> Vec<FileRef>`, `local_path(key) -> Option<PathBuf>`

`sha256` comes from the `sha2` crate. Keys are S3-style (`audio/<id>/<name>`); reject `..` and absolute keys.

## Specs
`features/blobs/*.feature` (`@rust-only`): put/get round trip, `head` sha256, `list` by prefix, rejected keys, `put_path` with `link`. Run them with a cucumber runner in the crate (`rust/crates/virtuus-blobs/tests/cucumber.rs`), and add the crate's tests and coverage to `make check-rust`.

## Verify
`make check PYTHON=$PWD/.venv/bin/python`, and `cargo tarpaulin -p virtuus-blobs` shows 100%.
